contexts.text: The derivative Knowledges are natural Truths.
Egypt = those who are in scientifics, or in natural Truths, which are the vessels of spiritual Truths.
For natural truth, spiritual truth. Signified.
For sensuous truth, natural truth. Signified.
The Spiritual of the external man is called natural truth.
Natural truth which had not yet acquired life. Signified, Explained. AC 1928:2.
A person concerning whom I had the idea that he was in natural truth...
The sea = natural truths.
The truth of the Natural is the Scientific which favours that delight.
Rational truths and natural truths. Signified, Explained.
By natural truths are meant scientifics of every kind...
The hoofs of His horses = natural truths.
Natural truth is their Scientific.
That natural truth is what is signified by a donkey. Illustrated.
The vastation of natural truth. Treated of.
The fourth state, which was one of natural truth. Signified.
Truth called forth from the natural man was to be conjoined with the good of the Rational. Treated of.
The multitude of the sea = the immense abundance of natural truth.

Natural truth is lower truth; and the affection of natural truth is the affection of lower truth. From this, general scientifics are proximately illustrated, which illustration penetrates further and affects more inwardly.
Spiritual things communicated to natural truth. Signified, Explained.
Natural truth is then every doctrinal and scientific for the sake of the end of being wise; that is, of doing these things.
Man is not born even into any natural truth; as that we are not to steal, etc.
From the auspices of Divine natural truth. Signified, Explained. AC 3192, Explained.
Between rational good and truth called forth from the Natural and made Divine, there is not effected a marriage, but a covenant like a conjugial covenant. Signified.
Israelites = those of the Spiritual Church who as to life are in simple good, and therefore as to doctrine are in natural truth. AC 3268:8. AC 4747.
The gentiles have not the truth of faith, but rational and natural truth. Signified.
Truth in the Natural is all that which is of knowledge, and is called scientific. (Continued. See Natural.)
The interior truth (in the Natural) is called natural truth; and the exterior is called sensuous. Both these are represented by Jacob.
The Natural as to truth is conceived from the truth of the Rational as a mother.
A hairy tunic = the truth of the Natural.
Hair = the Natural as to truth. Illustrated.
She called his name Jacob = the doctrine of natural truth.
Esau = the good of life of natural truth.
Hunting = the truths which are of the natural man from which are goods. AC 3313.

The good of the Rational inflows through the truth of the Rational into the truth of the Natural... and also through the good of the Natural into the Truth there... Signified. AC 3563:2. AC 3563:3. AC 3573. AC 3576.
Garments there = the truths of the natural man...
Dominion over the truths in the Natural. Signified.
An Egyptian = the truths of the Natural, which are scientifics.
The adjunction of natural truth from another source than the genuine one. Signified, Explained.
The vessels which receive good and truth from the Rational are the very truths of the Natural, which are nothing else than scientifics. Knowledges, and doctrinals.
The Lord's perception from Divine truth concerning natural truth. Signified, Explained. AC 3525.
Yearning and delight perceived by the Divine truth in the Divine Rational towards natural truth. Signified.
The apperception of natural truth. Signified.
The quality of natural good and natural truth in the state before regeneration. Explained.
The state of natural truth in that it then believed itself to be natural good from the external form. Signified.
A yearning to conjoin with himself natural truth through good. Signified.
Must = the natural truth thence. Illustrated. AC 3597.
Such things ought to be built upon the ideas of natural Truths, by which they ought to be apprehended, which also are at this day lacking.
No adjunction of natural truth from another source to the truth of the Rational. Signified, Explained.
See Knowledge.
Stones = lower truths, such as are of the natural man.
That natural truth, after it has been purified from falsities, is adopted by good. Representation.
That Divine natural truth would be as natural good. Signified, Explained.
The conjunction of natural truth through media with spiritual good. Treated of.
The affirming medium between natural truth and interior truth. Signified, Explained.
A hind let loose = the affection of natural truth in a free state.
By a servant was represented the truth of the Natural such as it is in the beginning, before genuine truths are insinuated. Explained.
The derivative power of natural Truths. Signified.
Waters = Knowledges and scientifics, which are the truths of the Natural.
The scientifics there pertain to the understanding, and are called natural truths.
Interior natural truths which are from the Divine. Signified.
Under Jacob, see this reference.
When interior natural truth spiritual was not yet risen. Signified.
The moon (as predicated of Leah) = natural truth.
Interior natural truths. Signified, Explained.
A he-goat of the she-goats = natural truths, that is, the truths of the external man from which are the delights of life... (and which are) truths Divine such as are those of the literal sense...
An Egyptian man = natural truth, Explained.
Good applying itself to the Scientific, or to natural truth, Signified, Explained.
See Natural good.
That (spiritual natural good) was forbidden to be conjoined with natural truth not spiritual. Signified. AC 4997. Explained.
That natural truth not spiritual wanted to be conjoined with spiritual natural truth. Signified, Explained. (What these two truths are, shown by examples. AC 5008:2.)
Natural truth (Potiphar's wife) cannot do otherwise than speak falsities... after ultimate spiritual truth... has been plucked away. Signified.
Egypt = the Scientific of the Church; thus natural truth which is the ultimate of order...
Seven cows ascending = the truths of the Natural. Explained.
Fine linen = natural truths.
Therefore they are sent back, and some good of natural truth is given gratis. Treated of.
That from spiritual light the truths in the Natural appear. Signified, Explained.
Truths in the Natural, and the Natural itself... act as a one; for the truths are the contents, and the Natural is the containant...
That (the medium) had (also) much of truth from the Natural. Signified, Explained.
For natural truth with all things of it must be initiated into the scientifics of the Church. Signified.
The elucidation of natural truth. Signified.
That the truths which were spiritual promoted natural truth. Signified, Explained.
The truth of the Natural in general, and the truths of the Natural in particular. Signified.
The perception of the truths in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
Joseph = the Internal, from which is truth in the Natural.
That the truth of the Natural was in scientifics. Signified.
That the natural truth, which is Jacob, was being elevated to the spiritual good, which is Israel. Signified.
Apperception from the truth of the Natural. Signified.
Communication of the truth of the Natural with the Internal. Signified.
Before the truth of the Natural was in scientifics. Signified.
Truth in the Natural for the External Church. Signified.

A certain one who was in natural truth, because when he lived in the world he had been in what is just, passed through many Hells... He was in such power... that the infernal Spirits could not infest him a whit...
Flax = the truth of the exterior Natural.
Spelt = the truth of the interior Natural.
Door-posts = the truths of the Natural.
Fish = the truth of the Natural.
Willows of the torrent = the lowest truths of the Natural.

In the Natural (the internal sight) has for its objects the truths of the civil state which are of what is just, and also the truths of the moral state which are of what is honest, and lastly the natural truths which are conclusions from the objects of the external senses, especially of the sight.
A donkey = the affection of natural truth.
A tooth = the exterior Intellectual, and the derivative natural truth; for this makes the life of that understanding. Illustrated.
A foot for a foot = if anything of the power of natural truth (was injured).
See Hair.
For correspondences are natural Truths, in which as in mirrors are represented spiritual Truths.
Both flax and fine linen = truth in the natural man.
For everything spiritual ceases in that which is called natural truth; and everything celestial in that which is called natural good; and there they subsist...

The truth of the natural man is signified by the water of the sea. This truth is scientific; for truth in the natural or external man is truth in knowledge... Hence it is that the truths with man in childhood are truths in knowledge...
Linen = external truth, or natural truth.
The two kidneys, and the fat upon their = the interior truth of the external or natural man, and its good.
Aromatic cinnamon = the perception and affection of natural truth... which truth is the interior truth of the external man.
Onycha = the affection of interior natural truth.
So long as truths are outside the life they are only natural; for they are known and thought only as other Things are.
Knowledge is of natural truth.
The natural truths with which every man is first imbued are like the leaves with which the branches are covered. Leaves, in the Word, = nothing else.
Divine natural truth. Signified, Explained.
Waters, in special, = natural truths, which are Knowledges from the Word. Illustrated.
That there was no longer any spiritual truth nor natural truth serving for doctrine and life from the Word with them. Signified, Explained. AE 527.
A rib of the breast, in the Word, = natural truth.
The woman was created from the man by the transcription of his Own wisdom, which is from natural truth...
That order may be perfect, celestial Truths and spiritual Truths ought to be rooted in natural Truths... The Knowledges and ideas of the Angels... are rooted in natural Truths.
Natural Truths, or Truths taken out from corporeal, worldly, and natural things, are the earthen vessels of spiritual Truths. Explained.
It is a natural Truth that...
Natural Truths serve to confirm it. SE 2604:2.
Natural Truths... are such vessels...
Concerning philosophical and natural Truths which are of service to them in confirming spiritual things. SE 2702.
Those there are those who have been in natural truth, and have lived a good life in and according to it.
Natural Truths are in place of a foundation...
(To such) the Word is to be unfolded by natural Truths. (Continued. See Foundation.)
That he shall chastise evils by the truths which are in the natural man. Signified, Explained.
Natural truth is truth in the memory and not in the life...

Truths in the natural man are the scientifics and Knowledges from which a man can think, reason, and conclude naturally concerning the truths and goods of the Church, and concerning the falsities and evils which are opposite to them; and thence be in a certain natural illustration when he is reading the Word. Explained.
The truth which is of the love of self or of the world is merely natural, because it comes from man and from the world. Explained.
By the truths of the natural man are meant the Knowledges of truth...
Ephraim = those who are in natural truth. Natural truth is such as is the truth of the Word in the sense of the letter.
For the truths of the natural man are the Knowledges of truth and good.
That the power of natural truth from spiritual will convince... those who are in falsities and evils. Signified, Explained.
See Natural good.
Those things which are in the natural mind from the spiritual are called natural truths, etc.

Natural truths, which are the truths of the sense of the letter... are not the truths themselves of Heaven, but are appearances of them, and appearances of truth encompass, enclose and contain the truths of Heaven... and cause that they are in connection and order, and that they cohere like the cardiac and pulmonary things with their coverings and ribs... and when they are in connection and order, then first are they holy...
Angelic wisdom... is founded upon natural Truths.
